source.basis: Published reference-design documents supplied by the user. The PDFs are not bundled; every figure is traceable through the SHA-256 in the extraction and the document and page recorded on each row.

status: R1 supersedes the R0 datasheet. Design temperatures are not restated in this set and are carried from R0.

expected.evidence: 4.2 R1, NetShelter MGX v1.2 x64 installed
4.2 R1, NetShelter MGX v1.1 x32; 2.5 R1 gives 8 SMN + 8 N/S + 8 CME + 8 CIN
2.5 R1: the 16 high racks are 8 CME at 35 kW and 8 CIN at 45 kW, an exact 40 kW average. Total networking load is 880 kW.
4.2 R1 Motivair MCDU-70 x8; 3.2 R1 shows CDU 1.1-1.4 and 2.1-2.4
4.2 R1 Uniflair FWCV40L2A x4; 3.2 R1 shows FW 1-4 each with one balancing valve
3.3 Uniflair XCAF2524G x2, 2223 kW Dallas, N+1 feeding the fan walls
3.2 R1 shows CWP1-CWP6 in two banks of three; 3.3 gives a range of 5-8 to be sized upon design implementation
expected.adjudication: GENERATOR LIMITATION, not a design difference. plant.pumps lays a bank out along +Y from the plant origin, so from the third unit it crosses the chiller supply and return collectors at py+4 and py+6 at the same elevation. The generator's own clearance check correctly rejects that layout, so the preset carries two per bank. The parameter advertises 1-8 and only 1-2 place legally; the bank needs its own corridor or a reversed growth direction with matching junction axes.

expected.evidence: RD113DS R0 p4/p9, compute 96% liquid / 4% air; not restated in the R1 set
RD113DS R0 p4/p9; not restated in the R1 set
45-55 C. No flow rate is published anywhere in the set, so the preset uses the heat-balance basis and the prescribed flow must reproduce this rise.
4.2 R1, Motivair MCDU-70 nameplate 2.5 MW at 4 degC approach. 3.2 R1 basis note: CDU flow rate is sized on all TCS racks at Max-P (227 kW).
expected.adjudication: Two differences compound, and the Motivair selection table separates them - see references/benchmarks/motivair_mcdu70_in_rd113.json. Operating state: RD113 sizes the CDU on Max-P (227 kW) while this preset carries Max-Q (188 kW). Redundancy: RD113 allocates across six of eight units on one TCS loop, about 2.4 MW each, which the 2.5 MW rating covers; this generator treats the two pods as independent and takes the worst case where both requested outages fall in the same pod, leaving two of four to carry it. The generator's figure is the stricter one. Resolve by confirming whether RD113 permits load transfer between pods, or whether the outage requirement is per pod rather than global.

expected.evidence: 3.3, Uniflair XCAF2524G 2223 kW Dallas, 2 units N+1, serving the fan walls only
expected.adjudication: The generator routes the whole plant load through one chiller bank. RD113 splits it: air-cooled chillers serve the fan walls, adiabatic fluid coolers serve the L2L CDUs. That two-plant architecture is not representable in the current plant model, so the chiller duty here is the full plant load rather than the fan-wall load alone.

not_published.note: No diameters, materials, insulation or support spacing anywhere in the supplied set. Only DN150 appears, on the pressurisation and expansion connections. Steps 3 to 6 of the sizing chain stay unchecked against RD113.
3.3 states CWP are 'to be sized upon design implementation'. No duty point, so nothing here validates the head calculation.
3.2 gives tags and topology but no Kv, Cv, allocated pressure drop or operating range for any ISV, PCV or BAV. The required-Kv result stays unchecked.

The Motivair selection table has since supplied the MCDU-70 flow rates, connection size and available head, so those are now checked. It publishes no pressure-drop curve, so cdu_design_dp_kPa remains a declared project input.
RD113_3.2 states it depicts system connections and is NOT representative of physical layout. The layout drawing is RD113_1.1X, which was not supplied, so routed lengths and clearances stay unchecked.

topology_differences.rd113: PCV01-PCV64, one pod control valve per AI rack, flanked by isolation valves on the branch
topology_differences.generator: one balancing valve on each rack return, plus isolation valves
topology_differences.effect: A control valve modulates and needs an operating range, authority and rangeability; a balancing valve is set once. The generator computes a single required Kv at one design point either way, so it cannot size the RD113 device correctly.

topology_differences.rd113: ET-1 to ET-4 and DAS-1, DAS-2 - one pair per circuit
topology_differences.generator: one expansion tank and one air separator on the FWS pump suction
topology_differences.effect: The generator models a single facility circuit; RD113 runs two.

topology_differences.rd113: air-cooled chillers for the fan walls, adiabatic fluid coolers for the L2L CDUs
topology_differences.generator: one plant serving the whole load
topology_differences.effect: Two independent rejection plants are not representable; see the chiller_duty_kW adjudication.

topology_differences.rd113: 8 CIN racks at 45 kW are liquid-cooled
topology_differences.effect: 360 kW sits on the air side in the model and on the TCS side in RD113.
